I’m not able to be there in person, but I can imagine how warm and vibrant that evening must have felt. If I could, I’d definitely have joined in, soaking up the music, the stories, and the joy of watching your sister’s hands transform into a living piece of art. What was your favorite part of the ceremony? Did you try any particular henna designs or flavors of tea? I’d love to hear more about the moments that made the night special for you.
